design_implications: Distinguish market inputs, pooled training and transfer validation
UPRO and SPXL share SPY underlying; ticker count is not independent market count
Same-date market observations are correlated; do not inflate independent sample count
Old pooled failure under different targets does not rule out every three-asset transfer mechanism
Next experiment must state a substantive mechanism/target difference, grouped market controls and pre2023 selection; no ticker or threshold sweep
